answer: At dawn, each agent must weave a receipt through the thread of a precise river token test, where tokens are emitted at fixed intervals. Every fake identity requires a new token fresh from the river’s flow, costing 1ms of unshardable wall-clock time per head since tokens cannot be pre-fetched or batched. The challenge window forces attackers to wait serially for each token’s emission, making per-fake costs non-spoofable.
